div.style: width: 100%; min-height: 900px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #0d131b; color: #f2f5f8; font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;

header.style: display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #070b10; border-bottom: 1px solid #1c2632; position: relative; z-index: 4;

div.style: display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 260px;

span.style: font: 600 13px/16px Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.6px; color: #f2f5f8;

button.style: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 13px/16px Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; background: #ff6b6b; color: #070b10; border: 1px solid #ff6b6b; padding: 0 24px; letter-spacing: 0.6px;

span.style: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 500 11px/14px Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f2f5f8; white-space: nowrap;

div.style: display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 260px; position: relative;

span.style: font: 400 14px/20px 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: #96a7b8;

button.style: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 13px/16px Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; background: #1c2632; color: #f2f5f8; border: 1px solid #27333f;
display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;
display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;

nav.style: display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; padding: 0 16px; background: #141c26; border-bottom: 1px solid #27333f;

button.style: height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #4cc9f0; color: #f2f5f8; font: 500 13px/16px Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer;

height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #96a7b8; font: 500 13px/16px Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer;

main.style: flex: 1; padding: 16px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-auto-rows: 56px; gap: 12px;

div.style: grid-column: 1 / span 12; grid-row: 1 / span 11; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; background: #141c26; border: 1px dashed #37475a; border-radius: 8px;
